content: Soaloalopwoat en Israel

KAUN-O ketin mahsanih, “Ma ohl emen pahn mweisang eh pwoud, oh liho ahpw pwoudikihda emen ohl tohrohr, ohl me e tepin pwoudikio sohte kak pwurehng kapwurehdo liho. Met uhdahn pahn kasaminehla sahpwo. Ahpw Israel, omw mwohnlimpoak me ngeder, eri, met ke men pwurodohr rehi!

Kilengdawohng pohn dohl kan. Mie wasa kis me ke sohte wia ie omw tiahk en netiki paliweromwen? Ke kin uh awiawih ohl akan ni keilen ahl akan pwe ke en nenekih, duwehte mehn Arepia men eh kin awiawih sounseiloak kan nan sapwtehn. Ke kasaminehkilahr sahpwo omw tiahk en netiki paliweromwen.
Ihme keteu solahr mwerki, oh sohla keteu mwurin ahnsoun kopou. Ke pil wialahr mwomwen lihen netiki paliwere; ke sohte mwahn kin namenek.
“A met ke ndahng ie, ‘Komwi me semei, oh komw kin poakohng ie sangete ni ei seri.
Omwi engieng sohte pahn poatopoat; komwi sohte pahn engieng pahi kohkohlahte.’ Israel, ihme ke nda, ahpw ke wiadahr mehkoaros me suwed.”
Israel oh Suda en Wiliakapwala

Ni mwehin Nanmwarki Sosaia, KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong ie, “Ke kilangehr dahme Israel, lih soaloalopwoato, wiadahr? E keseielahr, e ahpw kin wiewia tiahk en netiki paliwere pohn dohl ile oh pahn tuhke losolos koaros.
I kupwukupwure me mwurin eh wiahier mepwukat koaros, e uhdahn pahn pwurodo rehi. Ahpw e sohte pwurodo, oh Suda, rie serepein soaloalopwoato kilangehr mepwukat koaros.

Suda pil kilangehr ei mweisang Israel oh kadaralahr pwehki eh keseielahr oh wialahr lihen netiki paliwere. Ahpw Suda, rien Israel serepein soaloalopwoato, sohte masakada. Pwe e pil wiahla lihen netiki paliwere
oh sohte mwahn namenengki. E kasaminehla sahpwo, oh wiahda dipen kamwahl ni eh kaudokiong takai oh tuhke kan.
Oh mwurin mepwukat koaros, Suda, rien Israel serepein soaloalopwoato, mwomwehdahte me e pwurodo rehi; e sohte nan kapehd mehlel. Ngehi, KAUN-O, me mahmahsen.”
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong ie, me mehnda ma Israel kesehla, ahpw e mwahusang Suda, me soaloalopwoato.
E mahsanihong ie I en patohla oh patohwanohng Israel, “Kowe Israel me soaloalopwoat, pwurodo rehi. Pwe I me kupwurkalahngan oh sohte pahn engieng; I sohte pahn engieng pahmw kohkohlahte.

Ihte sakarkihda me ke dipadahr oh kahngohdiong KAUN-O, omw Koht. Sakarkihda me ke kihongehr omw limpoak ong koht en liki kan pahn tuhke losolos koaros oh me ke sohte kapwaiada ei kosonned kan. Ngehi, KAUN-O, me mahmahsen.

“Aramas soaloalopwoat akan, kumwail pwurodo; uhdahn nei kumwail. I pahn ale emen kumwail sang nan ehuehu kahnimw oh riemen sang nan ehuehu peneinei, oh I ahpw pahn kapwureikumwaildohng pohn Nahna Saion.
I pahn ketikihong kumwail kaun akan me kin peikiong ie, oh re pahn kaunkumwailda ni kupwurokong oh dehdehki.
Eri, ni amwail pahn ngederla nan sahpwo, aramas akan pahn sohla koasoia duwen ei Kopwahn Inowo. Re pahn sohla medemedewe de tamanda; re pahn pil sohla anahne de sohte wiahda pil ehu.

Ni ahnsowo eh pahn leledo, Serusalem pahn adanekihla ‘Mwoalen KAUN-O,’ oh wehi koaros pahn pokonpene wasao pwe re en kaudokiong ie. Re pahn mweisang ar keptakai oh ar mohngiong suwed kan solahr pahn pangenkin irail en wia me suwed.

Israel pahn iangala Suda, ira ahpw pahn ehupene oh pwurodohsang ara kalipilipala nan sahpw me mi ni paliepeng oh pahn pwurodohng nan sahpw me I ketikihongehr amwail pahpa kahlap ako pwe re en sapwenikihla kohkohlahte.”
Sapwellimen Koht Aramas akan Pwongih Dikedik en Eni
KAUN-O ketin mahsanih,

content.text: oh ketikihong uhk ehu sahpw kaperenen,
sahpw me keieu kaselel nan sampah.
I men ke en ekerkin ie semomw
Ahpw duwehte lih pwopwoud soaloalopwoat men,
Mwoarong ehu peipeido sang pohn dohl kan:
iei mehn Israel me wie sengiseng oh wie pekipek
Kumwail sapahldo, kumwail koaros me sohpeisangehr KAUN-O;
e pahn ketin kakehleikumwailda oh kupwurehda pwe kumwail en loalopwoatala.

content: Kumwail ahpw nda, “Ei, se pahn pwuralahng rehn KAUN-O pwehki ih me atail Koht.
Sohte sawas ehu kohieng kiht ni at wia kaudok en me rotorot pohn dohl akan. Sawas ong Israel kin kohsangete rehn KAUN-O, atail Koht.
Ahpw kaudokiong Paal, koht en kanamenek, kahredahr eh solahr neitail sihpw oh kou, pwutak oh serepein—mehkoaros me atail pahpa kahlap ako koadoahkihadahr sang kawa kohdo.

Konehngete kitail en namenekla oh pwainkinkitaildier atail namenek. Kitail oh atail pahpa kahlap ako kin wiewia dihp ong KAUN-O, atail Koht ahnsou koaros; kitail sohte mwahn kin kapwaiada sapwellime mahsen kan.”
